subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw expose Docker host IPC for agent sandboxes, and if yes should it be a narrow typed `sandbox.docker.ipc` break-glass field instead of generic raw Docker argument passthrough?
rationale: Current main and the latest release solve GPU passthrough, but the remaining host IPC/raw-args request changes the sandbox isolation boundary and public config contract.

options.title: Add typed IPC break-glass field
options.body: Expose a default-off `sandbox.docker.ipc` setting with validation, docs, config hashing, security-audit visibility, warnings, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

options.title: Reject host IPC in core
options.body: Document typed GPU passthrough as the supported high-power Docker path and keep host IPC unavailable because it weakens sandbox isolation.

options.title: Define broader namespace policy first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers decide one policy for IPC, PID, network namespace joins, capabilities, and other dangerous Docker options.

recommendation.title: Add typed IPC break-glass field
recommendation.body: Expose a default-off `sandbox.docker.ipc` setting with validation, docs, config hashing, security-audit visibility, warnings, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is closest to steipete's recent dangerous Docker override and namespace-isolation policy history.
